title: OpenREL Normalized Action Registry
description: Core reusable action set for OpenREL/ODRL policies. Variations and qualifications are expressed as constraints, not separate actions. All actions map to odrl: terms where available.

actions.label: Use
actions.definition: Generic usage of a resource. The broadest permitted action; all other actions are subsumed unless explicitly prohibited. Use constraints to express purpose, duration, or role restrictions.
actions.notes: Preferred action for general data access policies. Replaces the draft vocabulary's over-specific actions such as 'commercialUse', 'reuseResources', 'deployAIForResearch', 'collectData', 'storeData', etc., which are all instances of 'use' qualified by constraints.

actions.label: Read
actions.definition: Read-only access to a resource without modification, redistribution, or derivation.
actions.notes: Narrower than 'use'. Use when access must be confined to read operations.

actions.label: Distribute
actions.definition: Transfer or share a resource with third parties. Encompasses sharing, disseminating, republishing, and redistributing.
actions.notes: Replaces the draft vocabulary's 'share', 'shareData', 'shareOpenData', 'disseminate', 'publishOpenly', 'shareFindings', 'shareResearchOutputs', 'shareResearchFindingsWithPublic'. Variations (non-commercial, attribution-required) become constraints.

actions.label: Modify
actions.definition: Alter, adapt, transform, or derive new content from a resource.
actions.notes: Replaces 'adapt', 'alter', 'migrateContent', 'migrateFormats'. Share-alike conditions become a constraint.

actions.label: Reproduce
actions.definition: Copy or replicate a resource without modification.

actions.label: Archive
actions.definition: Store a resource in a long-term repository for preservation purposes.

actions.label: Delete
actions.definition: Permanently remove a resource or a copy of it.
actions.notes: Most commonly appears as a postDuty after a time-bound or use-until-deletion policy (Sections 105, 117).

actions.label: Notify
actions.definition: Send a notification to a defined endpoint upon performing an action.
actions.notes: Used as postDuty in access notification policies (Sections 102, 107, 113). The target endpoint is expressed as a constraint.

actions.label: Log
actions.definition: Record an event to a designated logging or audit system.
actions.notes: Used as postDuty in logging policies (Section 112). Distinct from 'notify' in that logging is internal/durable, while notify is an active outbound signal.

actions.label: Attribute
actions.definition: Credit the original creator or rights holder when using, sharing, or publishing a resource.
actions.notes: Replaces the draft's action-level 'provideAttribution', 'acknowledgeSource', 'creditContributors', 'respectMoralRights'. These are all manifestations of a single attribution duty; differences in scope are expressed as constraint modifiers.

actions.label: Obtain Consent
actions.definition: Acquire and document informed consent from the data subject prior to processing, collection, or sharing of personal data.
actions.notes: No direct ODRL core mapping; expressed as a duty in GDPR-aligned policies. Legal basis is modelled as a constraint using dpv:hasLegalBasis.

actions.label: Anonymize
actions.definition: Transform data so that individuals cannot be identified.
actions.notes: Replaces 'anonymizeData', 'ensureDataAnonymization'. When used as a duty, it is a prerequisite before openrel:distribute.

actions.label: Encrypt
actions.definition: Apply cryptographic protection to data at rest or in transit.
actions.notes: Replaces 'encryptData'. Typically appears as a prerequisite duty alongside openrel:use or openrel:archive.

actions.label: Apply License
actions.definition: Attach a recognized licence to a resource, defining the terms for its use and distribution.
